nixos.expr: (let flake = builtins.getFlake (toString ./.); nixpkgs = flake.inputs.nixpkgsStable; system = "x86_64-linux"; in (nixpkgs.lib.nixosSystem { inherit system; specialArgs = { self = flake; }; modules = [ flake.nixosModules.default flake.inputs.vscodeServer.nixosModules.default { nixpkgs.hostPlatform = system; } ]; }).options)
